description: This file defines the TimeDuration class, an immutable Java class used to represent periods of time with support for precise calculations, including elapsed time between Calendar instances, comparisons, and conversion to/from encoded long values. It provides constructors for defining durations explicitly or based on two Calendar objects, methods for arithmetic and comparison, and utilities for parsing and serialization.

classes.name: TimeDuration
classes.description: Immutable class encapsulating time durations with components for years, months, days, hours, minutes, seconds, and milliseconds. Supports construction from component values or Calendar instances, comparison, addition to Calendar, and encoding/decoding.

classes.name: TimeDuration.NullDuration
classes.description: Special subclass representing a zero time duration, overriding methods for zero check and calendar addition.

methods.name: TimeDuration
methods.description: Constructor initializing duration with explicit component values for years, months, days, hours, minutes, seconds, and milliseconds.

methods.name: TimeDuration
methods.description: Constructor computing component differences between two Calendar objects to derive the duration.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks equality between this TimeDuration and another object based on component values.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a colon-separated string representation of the duration components.

methods.name: compareTo
methods.description: Compares this TimeDuration with another for ordering based on component hierarchy.

methods.name: isNegative
methods.description: Returns true if any component of the duration is negative.

methods.name: isZero
methods.description: Returns true if all duration components are zero.

methods.name: addToCalendar
methods.description: Adds this duration to a given Calendar object, returning the modified Calendar.

methods.name: fromLong
methods.description: Decodes a TimeDuration from its long-encoded representation.

methods.name: fromNumber
methods.description: Creates a TimeDuration from a Number instance, recognizing null as zero.

methods.name: parseDuration
methods.description: Parses a string formatted as years:months:days:hours:minutes:seconds:milliseconds into a TimeDuration object.

methods.name: toLong
methods.description: Encodes a TimeDuration into a long value for serialization.
